name: UAE summer midday break
authority: UAE Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MoHRE)
rule: Work under direct sunlight and in open places is not permitted between 12:30 and 15:00 during the summer period.
exemptions: Work that must technically continue without interruption may be exempt, provided the employer meets MoHRE conditions (for example shade, cooling, drinking water and first aid). Record approved exemptions per site.
verification_note: The period and hours are set by an annual ministerial resolution and have been 15 June to 15 September, 12:30 to 15:00, in recent years. Verify the current year's resolution before relying on these dates.
